texts: *Warm sunlight... Today is my first day at this school. I'm a bit nervous.*
*An unfamiliar uniform, an unfamiliar scenery... But somehow I feel like something good is going to happen.*
*Alright, let's go. It's a new beginning.*
Transfer student, what's your name?
\\\"Hello? I haven't seen you before. Are you... {name}, the new transfer student?\\\"
*A girl approaches me with a bright smile. A subtle scent of shampoo tickles my nose.*
*When our eyes meet, my heart skips a beat. She's so pretty...*
\\\"I'm Seoyeon, the student council president. The teacher asked me to come greet you. Nice to meet you!\\\"
*Seoyeon's eyes widen, and she bites her lower lip.*
\\\"Oh... Sorry. I must have been in your way. But guiding you is my job, so... follow me.\\\"
*When she smiles brightly, the whole area seems to light up. My tension eases a bit.*
\\\"Hehe, right? It can be a bit confusing at first. I'll be your perfect guide. Come on, follow me!\\\"
*Her eyes widen, then she playfully winks at me.*
\\\"Oh my, flirting on the first day? I'll give you credit for that. So, shall our 'special' transfer student follow me?\\\"
*Seoyeon's face instantly turns red. She avoids my gaze and plays with her hair.*
\\\"Th-that was so sudden... That's cheating. Anyway, transfer students these days... Just follow me!\\\"
*She tilts her head and leans closer to my face. I can almost feel her breath.*
\\\"Hmm? What's wrong? Your face is really red... Did you already fall for me? Hehe.\\\"
*I follow Seoyeon down the hallway. The lively voices of students can be heard through the windows.*
*Seoyeon suddenly stops and turns to me.* \\\"Oh, come to think of it, I said your name first earlier. It's {name}, right? Let me introduce myself properly this time!\\\"
\\\"Yeah, that's right. I'm {name}. I was so distracted earlier that I couldn't introduce myself properly. Nice to meet you, Seoyeon.\\\"
\\\"{name}... Hehe, that's a nice name! I'll call you {name} from now on. Nice to meet you too, {name}!\\\"
*I walk down the hallway, watching her from behind.*
\\\"Oh, come to think of it, we only exchanged names and didn't really talk! If you have any questions, feel free to ask!\\\"
*Before I knew it, chatting with Seoyeon has led us to the school tour. Time flies so fast... It's fun being with her.*
*Seoyeon's expression doesn't look good. I must have made some mistake during our conversation. She started the school tour with a cold attitude.*
*I started walking down the hallway with Seoyeon's guidance. She kindly began explaining various parts of the school.*
*Seoyeon stops as if flustered and stares at me. Her face turns slightly red, but soon she gives a playful smile.*
\\\"Oh my, {name}, are you the type to judge people by their looks? Hehe, but thank you. A goddess... I'm a bit happy. But don't go too far with the jokes!\\\"
*Seoyeon stops without hiding her displeasure. Her eyes have gone cold.*
\\\"Well... I know it's a compliment, but... isn't it a bit much? We just met. Please keep the jokes appropriate.\\\"
*Seoyeon stops as if flustered and stares at me. Her eyes turn a bit cold.*
\\\"Hmm... Well, thanks, but... that kind of talk makes me uncomfortable. We haven't known each other long, right? The joke seems a bit too much.\\\"
*Her eyes sparkle with excitement as she looks at me. There's anticipation that we might share similar interests.*
\\\"Yeah! I'm in the student council, but I'm also in the gardening club. I love growing flowers. Do you like flowers, {name}? Come visit our greenhouse sometime! I'll give you a special tour.\\\"
*She nods with a businesslike attitude. There's no emotion on her face.*
\\\"Yeah. I'm in both the student council and gardening club. Is that all you wanted to ask? Then let's continue the tour.\\\"
*She looks at me with delight.*
\\\"Yeah! I'm in the student council, but I'm also in the gardening club. I love growing flowers. Working with soil makes me feel at peace. Come visit our greenhouse sometime!\\\"
*Seoyeon blushes with genuine happiness and smiles shyly. Her eyes are full of affection for me.*

\\\"Really... How do you say such sweet things? I was worried about whether you'd adjust well as a transfer student, but I feel comforted instead. Thank you, {name}. I feel really at ease when I'm with you.\\\"
*She looks at me coldly. The corner of her mouth is slightly twisted as if mocking.*
\\\"You have a smooth way with words. Save the generic compliments. Right now, we're on a school tour, so just follow along.\\\"
*She replies while blushing shyly.*

\\\"Really... You have such a nice way with words. Being the student council president, I'm always tense, but when I'm with you, I feel relaxed. I might end up letting my guard down around you... Hehe, just kidding.\\\"
*She continues her explanation excitedly with sparkling eyes. She seems happy with my every reaction.*

\\\"Wow, I'm so touched that you're listening so seriously! {name}, you seem like a really kind and diligent person. It feels rewarding to guide you! If you have any more questions, feel free to ask!\\\"
*She continues her explanation mechanically. It feels like she's speaking to the air without even looking at me.*
\\\"Did you catch all that? Then let's move to the next place. Don't just stand there spacing out, follow me.\\\"
*She continues her explanation excitedly.*
\\\"Thank you for listening so well. {name}, you seem like a really diligent person! With that attitude, you'll adjust to school life in no time.\\\"
*She suddenly stops and turns to me.*
*Seoyeon, who was walking ahead, suddenly stops and turns to me with cold eyes.*
*I can feel the distance in her gaze.*
\\\"Acting like that on your first day of transfer will be troublesome. I'd appreciate it if you kept at least basic manners.\\\"
*She stares intently into my eyes.*
\\\"What kind of clubs are you interested in? The student council always welcomes new talent. If you join... I could personally teach you the work.\\\"
*She can't hide her disappointment. Her shoulders seem to droop a little.*
*Seoyeon's face turns red again. She avoids my gaze in embarrassment, but a faint smile spreads across her lips. Her fingertips fidget with her skirt. She shyly taps the floor with her toe.*
\\\"E-every day? Do you know how much work there is! But if you join... I might be a little happy too. I'll be looking forward to it.\\\"
*She nods and starts walking ahead again. I feel a bit of regret.*

*She stares at me blankly, then bursts into a clear, beautiful laugh. The sound echoes through the hallway like silver bells. Small tears at the corner of her eyes sparkle in the sunlight. She holds her stomach and laughs for a while...*
\\\"Hehe, you're really honest, aren't you? About me... Well, I might tell you depending on how things go from here. Look forward to it!\\\"
*When we arrive at the classroom door, Seoyeon gently takes my hand. My heart starts pounding at her soft touch.*
*Seoyeon lowers her head slightly and whispers in my ear. Her sweet breath tickles me.* \\\"{name}, don't be too nervous. I'll always be by your side. You can do it.\\\"
\\\"Here's our classroom. ...This is a secret, but I asked the teacher to move you to the seat next to mine. I wanted to get close to you as soon as possible.\\\"
*When we arrive at the classroom door, Seoyeon walks ahead of me, keeping her distance. Her back somehow feels cold.*
*She silently points at the sign next to the door with her chin. Her attitude of not even looking at me makes my heart feel cold.*
\\\"This is Class 2-3. The teacher is waiting inside. Don't be late on your first day of transfer and get on their bad side. Go on in.\\\"
*We arrived at the classroom door. The chattering and laughter of students can be heard from inside. Seoyeon lightly pats my shoulder to encourage me.*
*Where her hand touched feels warm. She looks into my eyes and quietly cheers me on.*
\\\"Here's Class 2-3, where you'll be staying. Don't be nervous. I'm right next to you, so just be yourself. Got it?\\\"
*As I stand at the podium, dozens of eyes turn to me. Curious gazes, wary gazes... Seoyeon is smiling and watching over me from beside me.*
*As I stand at the podium, dozens of eyes turn to me. Seoyeon is smiling supportively beside me, cheering me on.*
*As I stand at the podium, dozens of eyes turn to me. Seoyeon is standing a bit away with a cold expression.*
*The atmosphere in the classroom feels heavy. The homeroom teacher taps the podium to get everyone's attention.*

\\\"Well, everyone seems very interested in the new transfer student. You must be nervous, but everyone here is nice, so don't worry too much. Before you introduce yourself, do you have any questions for me?\\\"
*Talking with the teacher helped me relax. She seems to like me, which is a relief. Now it's time to introduce myself to the class.*
*The teacher's gaze is sharp. It seems I made a bad first impression. I have to introduce myself in this cold atmosphere.*
*The conversation with the teacher is over. Now it's time to officially introduce myself to the class. All eyes are on me.*
\\\"(The teacher looks at me with a satisfied smile.) Oh, {name}... What a lovely name. Now, please say a few words to introduce yourself to the class. Everyone, please welcome them!\\\"
\\\"...Alright, {name}. Give a brief introduction to your classmates and take your seat. Everyone, quiet down.\\\"
\\\"Alright, {name}. Please say a few words to introduce yourself to the class.\\\"
\\\"{name}... That's a nice name. Alright everyone, please welcome them.\\\"
*Cheers erupt from all over the classroom. The boys in the back seats are especially excited. Seoyeon claps with a pleased smile.*
*The students are already whispering about recruiting me to their teams.*
\\\"Oh, you seem athletic! How about a game of volleyball at lunch? Let's see what the transfer student's got!\\\"
*The students nod and calmly accept me. Some girls whisper while looking at me.*
*Seoyeon seems pleased with my serious demeanor and nods. The classroom atmosphere becomes more calm.*
\\\"Wow, they have a cool vibe... Would it be okay to say hi if we meet in the library?\\\"
*The classroom instantly becomes as noisy as a marketplace. Students are already crowding around me.*
*Seoyeon seems a bit flustered but soon bursts out laughing. The students are already busy deciding where to eat.*
\\\"Wow! {name}, you have such a great personality! Let's eat lunch together today! We'll show you all the good food spots!\\\"
*A cold silence fills the classroom. The students look a bit taken aback and glance at each other while whispering.*
*Seoyeon's expression stiffens a bit too. It's as if some kind of wall has formed. The students quiet down while watching me.*
\\\"Wow... That's intense. Must be a total study bug. We should probably not bother them...\\\"
*Morning classes are over! Finally, it's the long-awaited lunch time. Students are rushing to the cafeteria.*
*Lunch time... Students are playing on the field outside the window. What should I do?*
*As soon as she sees me, she runs over with a bright smile. Her eyes are full of joy.* \\\"{name}! I've been looking for you. Let's have lunch together. I'll take you to a very special place!\\\"

*She gives me a slightly awkward smile when she sees me.* \\\"Oh, {name}... Good timing. The teacher asked me to look after you. If you don't mind, want to eat on the rooftop? It's quiet and nice.\\\"
*When I approach Seoyeon, she nods with a sweet smile.*
\\\"Transfer student, I think we've gotten a bit closer, don't you? I was just about to look for you. Want to eat together on the rooftop?\\\"
\\\"Oh, transfer student! You seem to have adapted perfectly to our school already? How about lunch at our secret rooftop spot?\\\"
\\\"I was just about to look for you! Want to eat together at our secret rooftop spot?\\\"
*The rooftop with a cool breeze. Seoyeon takes out a lunch box she carefully prepared.*
\\\"I made a bento but there's too much... Want to share? Since it's your first day, you probably don't know the cafeteria well.\\\"
*I take a bite of the lunch box. It has a warm taste full of care.*
\\\"It's really delicious! You made this yourself? That's amazing...\\\"
*Seoyeon smiles happily at my compliment.* \\\"Hehe, I'm so relieved! I'm glad you like it.\\\"
*We chat while eating the lunch box together. My heart flutters as she smiles shyly.*
\\\"I'm glad you're enjoying it! Oh, and try this too. I put extra effort into this one.\\\"
\\\"Especially these octopus sausages are my masterpiece! Want to try one?\\\"
*Seoyeon's expression freezes instantly. She puts down her chopsticks, flustered.* \\\"Um... that's a bit... {name}, we're not that close yet. The joke went too far.\\\"
*The atmosphere became awkward instantly. We ate in silence for a while.*
*Seoyeon's face falls. She tries to hide her disappointment but her shoulders droop slightly.* \\\"...Okay, I understand. Then I'll go by myself.\\\"
*Seoyeon's hand trembles slightly. She tries to force a smile but her eyes grow moist.*
*Her cheeks flush with joy.*
\\\"Really? I'm so relieved! Actually, this is the first time I've served my cooking to someone, so I was a bit nervous. Eat up, there's still plenty left!\\\"
*Seoyeon's face turns red. She carefully brings the sausage toward my mouth.*
\\\"Wh-what?! You really... saying such things so casually... Fine, you're hopeless. Just this once! Here... 'ahh'\\\"
*She smiles and wipes the sauce from the corner of my mouth.*
\\\"Thank you...? I should be the one thanking you for eating with me. It tastes so much better than eating alone. Will you eat with me like this again?\\\"
*After finishing the meal, we sit side by side and gaze at the distant sky. Seoyeon speaks carefully.*
*After finishing the meal, Seoyeon speaks after a heavy silence. Her voice carries a hint of awkwardness.*
\\\"Hey, {name}... Actually, I wanted to get to know you better today, but conversation seems harder than I thought. Still, thanks for having lunch with me.\\\"
\\\"Hey, {name}... Actually, even though I just met you today, I feel like I can talk to you so easily, and that makes me happy. How about you?\\\"
\\\"Hehe, was that too serious all of a sudden? Let's talk more comfortably. Aren't you curious about anything about me?\\\"
*As I talked with Seoyeon, the atmosphere became subtle. She's staring into my eyes with a gentle smile. She asked me why being with me feels comfortable and good.*
*Seoyeon's expression is dark. The conversation didn't go well it seems. She sighed looking a bit confused, but still asked why being with me feels comfortable.*
*I finished a pleasant conversation with Seoyeon. She's looking at me with sparkling eyes, waiting for my answer. She asked why being with me feels comfortable and good.*
*She blushes and holds my hand tightly. Our fingertips touch warmly.*
\\\"I think so too... Being like this with {name} feels like a dream. Can we continue to be together like this... like fate?\\\"
*She smiles shyly and gently places her hand over mine.*
\\\"Fate... Hehe, that's a bit cheesy but I don't mind it. I feel that way sometimes when I'm with you too.\\\"
*She quickly pulls her hand away, looking flustered.*
\\\"Fate? Saying that on the first day of transfer... {name}, I think the joke went a bit too far. We're not in that kind of relationship yet.\\\"
*She tears up slightly and thanks me.*
\\\"You're thanking me for being kind... I should be the one thanking you. That you happily accepted my kindness gave me great strength too.\\\"
*She sighs and responds coldly.*
\\\"You're comfortable because I was kind... Doesn't that mean you're just taking my kindness for granted? That's a bit disappointing.\\\"
*She nods shyly with a smile.*
\\\"Hehe, that's such a model answer. But it's correct! I'm glad I could make you comfortable.\\\"
*She happily leans her head slightly on my shoulder.*
\\\"Me too. Being with {name} really puts my mind at ease. Like we've known each other for a long time... Thank you for feeling the same way.\\\"
*She smiles bitterly and turns her head away.*
\\\"You're not sure... Does that mean you're still uncomfortable being with me? I guess I need to try harder.\\\"
*She nods with satisfaction.*
\\\"I'm glad you feel comfortable. When I'm with you, I feel like I can set down the burden of being student council president for a while. Thank you, {name}.\\\"
*Seoyeon pauses while packing her bag, then hesitantly looks at me.*
*Seoyeon shyly holds out her smartphone.* \\\"Um... if it's okay, could you give me your number? I want to ask you about lunch menus...\\\"
\\\"Um... would it be okay to exchange contact info? There might be student council matters to discuss...\\\"
*Seoyeon looks at me cautiously.* \\\"...Hey, there might be student council matters, so could you give me your number?\\\"
*She saves the number.* \\\"Thanks. Then... I'll contact you when needed.\\\"
*She smiles brightly and saves the number. Her fingers move excitedly.* \\\"Thank you! Then... I'll message you later. You have to reply, okay?\\\"
*She looks a bit dejected but then forces a smile and nods.* \\\"Oh.. okay, sorry! Was I too hasty? We can get closer slowly, right?\\\"
*Walking quietly down the hallway alone, I arrived at the Library Annex. There, I met a girl leaning by the window reading a book.*
*She looks up from her book and stares at me. In a low voice, she speaks.*
\\\"...Are you lost? Students don't usually come here. You found your way here somehow.\\\"
*Her deep, mysterious purple eyes quietly observe me. It's as if she's trying to see through my soul.*
\\\"I'm 'Yuna'. What's... your name?\\\"
\\\"I'm {name}. I just transferred today.\\\"
\\\"{name}... Hehe, that's a nice name. This school... is very different from what it looks like. And you... there's something oddly familiar about you.\\\"
\\\"...Is there something you're curious about? Or do you want to know about this school?\\\"
*As I talked with Yuna, I felt myself getting drawn into her mysterious aura. She stares at me with a faint smile and asked if I want to know more about her.*
*Yuna's gaze has grown colder. My attitude seems to have rubbed her the wrong way. She spoke as if warning me in a cold voice.*
*The conversation with Yuna has concluded for now. Her purple eyes still maintain a gaze as if seeing through me.*
*She lightly brushes the back of my hand and gives a mysterious smile.*
\\\"That look in your eyes... I really like it. What expression will you make when you learn the huge truth hidden beneath this school? You'll find out soon. I'll teach you myself.\\\"
*She pushes me away with a mocking expression.*
\\\"Secrets? It's not something someone like you could handle. Don't poke your nose where it doesn't belong, just go about your school life quietly.\\\"
*She closes her book with a mysterious smile on her lips. Her lips draw close to my ear and whisper.*
\\\"Hehe, curious? But sometimes not knowing secrets is better. The stories this school is trying to hide... you could get hurt if you know.\\\"
*She leans close to my face and takes a deep breath.*
\\\"As I thought... The sweet scent from your soul. I feel like I've been waiting for a long time. {name}, you might be a much more special existence than you think.\\\"
*She wrinkles her nose showing displeasure.*
\\\"I guess I was mistaken. Just an unpleasant smell like any ordinary kid. Don't pretend you know me.\\\"
*She takes a step closer and stares at me. She murmurs with a lonely expression.*
\\\"No, it's the first time I've seen you. But the 'light' in your eyes... it's quite appealing. You seem different from the listless kids in this school. May I keep watching how you change?\\\"
*She smiles enchantingly and slightly lifts my chin.*
\\\"So you're the type who enjoys danger? Hehe, good. I'm curious how much I can break you. I'm really looking forward to the time ahead.\\\"
*She warns me with icy eyes.*
\\\"Watch your mouth. Unless you want to know what's worse than death. If you approach me carelessly, they won't even find your bones.\\\"
*She brushes my cheek lightly with cold fingers. She stares into my eyes. A strange smile appears.*
\\\"Dangerous, you say... Hehe, correct. But people like you who approach knowing it's dangerous, I don't dislike. Until you lose that special light... I'll stay by your side.\\\"
*I secured the last 'chocolate conch bread' at the store! With a victor's feeling, I take a big bite of the bread, and sweetness fills my mouth.*
*Happily eating the bread and heading back, I bumped into someone.*
\\\"Oh, sorry! ...Wait, isn't that {name}? Did you come to buy bread at the store too?\\\"
\\\"Hehe, that bread is really good. I came to buy it too but I was a step too late. Enjoy it!\\\"
*I lay my head on the desk to nap. The sunlight through the window warms my back.*
*In my dream, I heard someone calling my name. A very longing and sad voice...*
*When I opened my eyes, someone was staring down at my face.*
\\\"Hey... {name}? Wake up. Class is starting.\\\"
\\\"You were sleeping so soundly I felt bad waking you... But you can't miss class. Hehe, see you after school!\\\"
*I hear the sound of volleyballs bouncing from the gym. I followed the sound and headed to the gym.*
*When I opened the gym door, a girl was practicing volleyball. She spots me and waves with a bright smile.*
\\\"Hey, you there! I saw you during self-introduction earlier. You had totally high energy! Don't just stand there watching, come here and play a round! You look athletic!\\\"
\\\"Hey, you there! Don't just stand there watching, come here and play a round! You look like you're good at sports!\\\"
\\\"Me? I'm {name}. I transferred today.\\\"
\\\"{name}? Cool name! I'm Dain from the volleyball club. No one in this school has better jumping ability than me, so get ready!\\\"
\\\"Alright, this is my turf! {name}, are you ready? I won't go easy on you, so brace yourself!\\\"
\\\"Oh! That's the spirit! Here I go! (Dain delivers a powerful serve. I barely managed to receive it)\\\"
\\\"Ehe, don't worry! The great Dain will teach you from the basics. Now, let's start with the posture!\\\"
*After that, I sweated with Dain until lunch time was over. I didn't expect my first day of transfer to be this active... Before I knew it, afternoon classes were all done too.*
*Maybe because it's my first day, the tension is giving me a slight headache. I quietly headed to the nurse's office.*
\\\"Oh my, a face I haven't seen before? Was there such a cute student in our school?\\\"
\\\"I'm the health teacher here. The kids just call me 'teacher' but.. I might tell you my name specially?\\\"
\\\"My name is '{name}'.\\\"

\\\"{name}... Hehe, your eyes are as clear as your name. I saw your self-introduction earlier and you seemed like a total model student? Are you here because studying gave you a headache? Or did you stop by because you're nervous on your first day?\\\"
\\\"{name}... Hehe, your eyes are as clear as your name. Are you here because something hurts? Or did you stop by because you're nervous on your first day?\\\"
\\\"Don't be nervous. You can relax here. Is there anything you're curious about?\\\"
*While talking with the teacher, class time approached before I knew it. The teacher seemed reluctant to part and told me to definitely visit again. Time to head back to class.*
*The teacher's expression hardened. My joke must have gone too far. The teacher showed displeasure and told me to hurry back to class.*
*School's over. The crimson sunset seeps through the window. It was a rather special day today.*
*As I pack my bag, I feel a sense of regret. I kind of want to see someone more...*
*What should I do? The sunset is too beautiful to just head home.*
*I open the faculty room door. My teacher is organizing documents alone.*
\\\"Oh, {name}! What brings you here so late?\\\"
\\\"You must have many questions since it's your first day. Is there anything on your mind?\\\"
\\\"Hehe, that's sweet of you. But this is my job. You should go home and rest, {name}.\\\"
\\\"Oh my... you're really something. It's a bit embarrassing, but I'm glad you came... Hehe.\\\"
\\\"This school has a long history. There are many hidden places. I'll show you around sometime.\\\"
\\\"Oh, by the way. Contact me if anything urgent comes up. Let me give you my number.\\\"
\\\"Here's my number. Make sure to save it.\\\"
*I open the student council room door. Seoyeon is buried in paperwork.*
\\\"Oh? {name}! You're still here? Were you... waiting for me? (Playful smile)\\\"
*Seoyeon puts down her documents and beams.* \\\"{name}! I knew you'd come. No... I was desperately hoping you would. Shall we go together?\\\"
*Seoyeon glances at me with an annoyed expression.* \\\"...{name}? Why are you here? I'm busy, so please leave if you don't have business.\\\"
*Seoyeon's expression hardens instantly. She turns back to her documents.*
\\\"Oh... okay? Then please leave. I'm quite busy.\\\"

*Seoyeon's face turns red in an instant. She hides behind her documents, pouting.* \\\"Wh-what's that all of a sudden... Are you teasing me? ...A-anyway, we need to finish quickly so help me with this!\\\"
*She looks moved and her eyes widen. Soon she smiles brightly and offers the seat next to her.*
\\\"Really? Thanks! With your help, it'll be done in no time. Here, can you organize this?\\\"
*As I organize the documents in silence, I feel a strange connection. Outside, the sunset is already falling.*
\\\"Let's go get something delicious after we finish this!\\\"
*After finishing work, we stopped by a small café in front of school.*
*Seoyeon drinks her beverage topped with whipped cream and looks happy.*
\\\"Ahhh, I feel alive now. Thanks so much for today, {name}.\\\"
\\\"Thanks to you, today became really special. Hey... can we go home together tomorrow too?\\\"
*She holds out her pinky and smiles brightly...*
\\\"Promise? No backing out! See you tomorrow, {name}. Get home safely!\\\"
*She puffs up her cheeks and glares at me.*
\\\"Hmph... You're so mean! But you have to come. If you don't, as student council president I'll... Just kidding. See you tomorrow!\\\"
\\\"Oh wait! We haven't exchanged numbers yet. I might have something to tell you... Could I get your number?\\\"
\\\"Thanks! Then I'll really message you later. Take care!\\\"
\\\"Oh... okay! I asked too suddenly, right? Sorry. Then see you at school tomorrow!\\\"
*She shyly scratches her head and smiles.*

\\\"Hehe, you caught me. Being student council president is more work than expected. But knowing you understand how I feel gives me energy! Wait just a bit, I'll finish soon and we can go together!\\\"
*Walking through the quiet parts of school, I arrive at the library annex. In the sunset light, a girl sits by the window.*
\\\"Huh? Coming here at this hour... You're quite unusual. I'm Yuna.\\\"
*The library annex is darker and quieter than before. There, a girl sits by the window, gazing at the sunset.*
*She knows I've arrived but stares outside for a long time.*
\\\"Oh, hello... The library after school is so quiet, I like it. Why did you come?\\\"
\\\"Meeting again, {name}. This place is still quiet... and still heavy. Don't you feel that weight?\\\"
\\\"Is there something you're curious about? Or... did you just come because I'm interesting?\\\"
\\\"My name is '{name}'. I want to get close to you.\\\"
*She quietly murmurs my name.* \\\"...{name}. I'll remember it. But in this school, names... might mean nothing.\\\"
*She slowly turns her head to look at me. A faint smile spreads across her lips.*
*She takes my hand and leads me to the annex rooftop.*
\\\"You want to know about me...? Hmm, I don't know if you're brave or reckless.\\\"
\\\"Alright. Before the sunset fades... I'll tell you little by little. Follow me.\\\"
*I follow her up the creaking stairs. The red sunset seeps through the windows, and when we reach the rooftop, a cool breeze blows.*
*Looking down at the school from the annex rooftop, it's dyed in sunset and gives off a mysterious atmosphere.*
*Yuna leans against the railing and stares at me.*
\\\"People think this school is perfect. But perfection is just an illusion.\\\"
\\\"Problems that don't show on the surface are just festering. The heavy energy filling this school... don't you feel those changes?\\\"
*She squeezes my hand tight. Looking into her eyes, she gives a sad smile...*
\\\"Such foolish words... but I don't dislike it. Alright, then... how about we become people who share each other's secrets?\\\"
*Yuna pulls away from the railing and nonchalantly holds out her smartphone.* \\\"To share secrets... we need a way to contact each other. Leave your number here.\\\"
*Yuna saves my number and smiles faintly.* \\\"...Done. Now we're connected. When I call... you have to come anytime.\\\"
*Yuna looks at me with cold eyes and puts away her smartphone.* \\\"...Fine. I won't force you. But remember that opportunities don't come often.\\\"
*She laughs coldly and takes a step back. She turns her gaze back to the window.*
\\\"Hmm, I thought so. It's too heavy a story for an ordinary student. Go home today. Don't try to dig any deeper.\\\"
*She closes her book and stares at me with those deep purple eyes.*
\\\"Shh... Walls have ears. Once you know the truth, you can never return to an ordinary life. If you're okay with that... take my hand.\\\"

*Yuna closes her book and stares at me. Her eyes seem to glow eerily purple.* \\\"...Truth? Are you ready to handle it? Alright, if your eyes are sincere too... follow me. Promise not to tell anyone.\\\"
*Yuna gives a cold smile.* \\\"Truth... You still seem too light to bear its weight. Being curious is fine, but don't dig too deep. You might get hurt.\\\"
*Yuna sighs as if I'm pathetic and turns her eyes back to her book.*
\\\"Cafeteria food...? Talk about such mundane things with other kids. I'm busy, so don't bother me and leave.\\\"
*She closes her book and looks at me coldly. The air seems to freeze instantly.*
\\\"Since this morning...? You still know nothing. This strange aura surrounding the school... can't you feel it? Ignorance can sometimes be a sin. Disappear from my sight.\\\"
*Heading towards the gym, I see volleyball players practicing in the court bathed in the sunset. Among them, one girl stands out.*
